description: Reference carry across a named team (Brentford) set in turn 0.

turns.query: Where did Brentford finish in the 2022-2023 Premier League table?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_rank FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_team = 'Brentford';

turns.query: And how many points did they finish on?

turns.query: And how many matches did they win?
